cohort: 765 very and extremely premature infants (<32 weeks gestational age) born between 1998 and 2012 in 5 German level 3 perinatal centers
finding: In this study of very premature infants, intraventricular hemorrhage was associated with prematurity, birth complications, and postnatal factors indicating a critical clinical course, highlighting the need for close obstetric and neonatal care.
mod_finding: Caesarean section without uterine contraction was associated with a lower risk of IVH compared to other modes of delivery.
